documentation.content: Inspect service/API dashboard, correlated logs and trace waterfall. Check snapshot freshness before interpreting business counts. No-data alerts require always-on expected emitters and are disabled by default for scale-to-zero services. Do not retry money movement without its original idempotency key. Runbook: https://github.com/srinu7893/otel-payment-platform-poc/blob/main/docs/OTEL_REMAINING_FEATURES.md
